summary: Master cultural diversity management for international NGOs. Learn to lead inclusive global teams and drive localization. Enroll in our expert-led course.
lede: Diversity management in international NGOs helps humanitarian and development teams build inclusive practices across their operations. It is designed for program managers, operations directors, HR partners, coordinators and inclusion leads responsible for cross-cultural teams. Participants assess team culture, adapt communication for field offices, improve inclusive recruitment, and develop conflict-resolution and localization plans.
audienceIntro: This training is essential for professionals responsible for cross-border operations and multi-cultural team leadership within the non-profit and humanitarian sectors.
modules: Foundation of International NGO Diversity Management
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in a management or coordination role within an international NGO or humanitarian organization. Familiarity with basic project management cycles and the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) is recommended. No prior specialized DEI training is required, but an openness to self-reflection and challenging existing organizational norms is essential.
